ArcBrowserContext.lifecycle: Native context is an engaged optional shared handle at +0x30 (`0x443739c`); service accessors cache ObjC wrappers with associated-object policy 1: preferences `0x44374c0`, history `0x44376b0`, downloads `0x44378a0`, effects `0x4437a90`, extraction `0x4437c80`. Context delegate creation uses weak delegate/self (`0x43ed9a8`); bookmark observer vector owns shared bridge handles (`0x4437fe4`, `0x443808c`, `0x443f1968`, `0x443f21a8`). Destructor `0x4438580` releases those structures. Cached wrappers and native Profile shutdown are distinct lifetimes.
ArcBrowserContext.relations: Category overrides are essential: base id/metrics/extensions at `0x4084dc0`/`0x2d0fb40`/`0x2cb140` simply read ivars, while Extensions `0x43f541c` constructs native ID and `0x43f5648`/`0x43f598c` cache real service wrappers. Same-IMP aliases exist for changed-permissions/content-settings (`0x43ee38c`) and chat/product closure (`0x43f5cd4`). Native WebContents construction is `0x43f35bc` → `0x42d7064`; latter has the Arc browser_context_impl.cc CreateWebContents source marker. Delegate adapters `0x43f680c`/`0x43f68cc` invoke show/closed DevTools callbacks. Other vtable targets include missing exported entries `0x43f695c` and `0x43f6ae4`; their behavior is unresolved. URL loads, cookie/storage/favicon operations capture callbacks; callback queue and shutdown cancellation are unproven.
ArcBrowserContext.route: A replacement needs one coherent profile/service identity across bookmarks, content settings, cookie/storage partitions, importers, favicon, search and WebContents. Chrome API analogue: Chromium `d0c02bfad08ec92a6ffcf989e53cd995e6381a4c`, `chrome/browser/profiles/profile.h:68` (see source index for anchors), and targeted native bridge evidence in methods.tsv. This is a service-integration requirement inferred from calls, not proof each feature requires a private Chromium patch. CEF feasibility needs individual native service and app-call mapping; no mapping is claimed from names or absent source files.
ArcBrowserContext.questions: Establish profile-detach and shutdown sequencing; callback cancellation/queues; bookmark managed-node rules; partitioned cookie/storage behavior; import rollback; actual app-called subset. Recover missing delegate adapter bodies using disassembly if needed.
